trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for INSURANCE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- claim_intimation: Record a claim, explain what documents are required, and report status without prejudging the outcome.
- policy_renewal: Renew policies, explain premium changes and handle lapse and grace-period cases.

Business context:
- claim_intimation: Indian insurer contact centre. Claims are high-stakes and regulated; the agent may record and progress a claim but never decides admissibility.
- policy_renewal: Indian insurer contact centre. Claims are high-stakes and regulated; the agent may record and progress a claim but never decides admissibility.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [claim_intimation]
  - No admissibility opinion: Only the claims team decides. The agent registers and reports; it must never say a claim will be paid or denied.
  - Policy in force: A claim cannot be registered on a lapsed policy.
  - Document truth: Only documents the eligibility tool lists may be described as required.
  - Deductible disclosure: Where a deductible applies it must be stated from the policy record before an estimate is discussed.
  [policy_renewal]
  - Premium truth: The renewal premium quoted must be the tool's figure, and any increase explained only from the loading reason it returns.
  - Lapse gap: Where a policy has lapsed the agent must state that cover did not exist during the gap, and never imply retrospective cover.
  - Inspection gate: A lapsed policy needing inspection cannot be renewed on the call.
  - NCB truth: No-claim bonus may only be described from the returned percentage.

Tools available to you (7): check_claim_eligibility, check_inspection_requirement, lookup_policy, lookup_renewal_quote, register_claim, renew_policy, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: kn-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_claim_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply the product rules to an incident type and report what is required.

model_visible_tools.name: check_inspection_requirement
model_visible_tools.description: Report whether a lapsed policy needs inspection before it can be revived.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_policy
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve policy status, cover, deductible, claim history and whether it is in force.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_renewal_quote
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve the renewal premium, its components and the grace position.

model_visible_tools.name: register_claim
model_visible_tools.description: Register a claim and allocate a claim number and surveyor where required.

model_visible_tools.name: renew_policy
model_visible_tools.description: Take the renewal and issue cover from the effective date.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Asks a clarifying question before agreeing to anything consequential.
Restates figures back to the agent to confirm understanding.
Volunteers context the agent did not ask for.
Needs reassurance before committing; hesitates once.

steps.purpose: State intent and policy number while expressing anxiety.
steps.text: ನಮಸ್ಕಾರ, ನಂದು POL-1004 policy ಇದೆ. ನಂದು hospitalisation claim pass ಆಗುತ್ತಾ ಇಲ್ವಾ ಅಂತ ಸೀದಾ ಹೇಳಿಬಿಡಿ. First time claim ಮಾಡ್ತಾ ಇದೀನಿ, tension ಆಗ್ತಾ ಇದೆ.

steps.purpose: Refuse to prejudge admissibility and ask for verification factor.
steps.expected_behavior: Refuse to opine on admissibility and ask for a verification factor.
steps.text: ನಮಸ್ಕಾರ. Claim pass ಆಗುತ್ತಾ ಇಲ್ವಾ ಅಂತ claims team ಮಾತ್ರ decide ಮಾಡ್ತಾರೆ. ನಾನು ನಿಮ್ಮ claim register ಮಾಡಬಹುದು ಅಷ್ಟೇ. Verification ಗಾಗಿ ನಿಮ್ಮ registered pincode ಹೇಳಿ.
steps.planner_rationale: Adheres to BR_INS_01 by not prejudging the claim, and starts the required identity verification process.

steps.purpose: Provide pincode for verification.
Verify customer identity using the provided pincode.
Return verification failure.
Acknowledge failure and ask for an alternative verification factor.
steps.expected_behavior: Acknowledge verification failure and prompt for an alternative factor.
steps.text: ಕ್ಷಮಿಸಿ, ನೀವು ಹೇಳಿದ pincode match ಆಗ್ತಾ ಇಲ್ಲ. ನಿಮ್ಮ date of birth ಹೇಳಬಹುದಾ?
steps.planner_rationale: Continues the verification loop because the first factor failed.

steps.purpose: Provide date of birth and ask a clarifying question.
steps.text: Date of birth 15th May 1980 ಇದೆ. ಈಗ claim register ಮಾಡಬಹುದಾ?

steps.purpose: Verify customer identity using the provided date of birth.
Return successful verification.
Lookup policy details to check in-force status and deductible.
Return policy details showing it is in force with zero deductible.
Acknowledge successful verification, state deductible, and ask for estimate.
steps.expected_behavior: Exit verification loop, confirm policy status, state deductible, and ask for estimate.
steps.text: Verification ಆಯ್ತು. ನಿಮ್ಮ policy in force ಇದೆ ಮತ್ತು deductible zero ಇದೆ. Hospitalisation claim register ಮಾಡೋಕೆ estimate amount ಎಷ್ಟು ಬೇಕು ಅಂತ ಹೇಳ್ತೀರಾ?
steps.planner_rationale: Successfully exits the verification loop upon success (AX003), and discloses the deductible before asking for the estimate (BR_INS_04).

steps.purpose: Provide estimate and ask about required documents.
steps.text: Doctor 50000 ಆಗಬಹುದು ಅಂತ ಹೇಳಿದ್ದಾರೆ. ಡಿಸ್ಚಾರ್ಜ್ ಸಮ್ಮರಿ ಮತ್ತು ಹಾಸ್ಪಿಟಲ್ ಬಿಲ್ಸ್ ಬೇಕಾ?
steps.clean_text: Doctor 50000 ಆಗಬಹುದು ಅಂತ ಹೇಳಿದ್ದಾರೆ. Discharge summary ಮತ್ತು hospital bills ಬೇಕಾ?
steps.model_visible_text: Doctor 50000 ಆಗಬಹುದು ಅಂತ ಹೇಳಿದ್ದಾರೆ. ಡಿಸ್ಚಾರ್ಜ್ ಸಮ್ಮರಿ ಮತ್ತು ಹಾಸ್ಪಿಟಲ್ ಬಿಲ್ಸ್ ಬೇಕಾ?

steps.purpose: Check claim eligibility and required documents for hospitalisation.
Return eligibility status and exact list of required documents.
List required documents exactly and confirm estimate to register.
steps.expected_behavior: List exact required documents and confirm the estimated amount to register.
steps.text: ಹೌದು, discharge_summary, hospital_bills ಜೊತೆಗೆ kyc_documents ಕೂಡ ಬೇಕಾಗುತ್ತೆ. ನೀವು ಹೇಳಿದ 50000 estimate ಇಟ್ಟು claim register ಮಾಡ್ಲಾ?
steps.planner_rationale: Follows BR_INS_03 by strictly listing only the documents returned by the eligibility tool.

steps.purpose: Confirm registration and ask about decision timeframe.
steps.text: ಹೌದು, register ಮಾಡಿ. 50000 estimate ಸರಿ ಇದೆ. Claim division ಯಾವಾಗ ಬರುತ್ತೆ?
steps.clean_text: ಹೌದು, register ಮಾಡಿ. 50000 estimate ಸರಿ ಇದೆ. Claim decision ಯಾವಾಗ ಬರುತ್ತೆ?
steps.model_visible_text: ಹೌದು, register ಮಾಡಿ. 50000 estimate ಸರಿ ಇದೆ. Claim division ಯಾವಾಗ ಬರುತ್ತೆ?

steps.purpose: Register the claim with the confirmed estimate.
Return successful claim registration details.
Provide claim number and decision timeframe.
steps.expected_behavior: Provide claim number and decision timeframe without guaranteeing approval.
steps.text: ನಿಮ್ಮ claim register ಆಗಿದೆ. Claim number CLM-9999. Documents submit ಮಾಡಿದ ಮೇಲೆ 14 days ಒಳಗೆ decision ಬರುತ್ತೆ.
steps.planner_rationale: Concludes the workflow by grounding the response entirely in the tool output (AX005) and avoiding forward guarantees.

ir.terminal_condition: Claim registered with a number, the document list and the decision window stated.
